limitations: The Feishu source tables are rendered as images. The downloaded PDF also stores those tables as page graphics; pypdf text extraction returns no table-cell text. Local Vision OCR and visual page review were used; OCR typography is not proof of byte-for-byte equality.

Basic parts (27 rows) and Composite parts (12 rows) were fully reviewed at content/wording level after normalizing line breaks/whitespace. Exact Unicode punctuation, prime glyphs, × glyphs, and italics are not asserted where OCR could normalize them.

Strains Y03, Y05–Y09 contain promoter/construct description differences requiring scientific owner review. Composite BBa_260J9X0X adds a scientific construct description requiring review. None were implemented.
PDF export was done with the normal Feishu interface, body-only. No external service was used. Pagination may split table rows or continue descriptions onto the next page.
Only this JSON comparison record remains in the task source tree; the three original PDF files are preserved under the external Claude handoff run inputs directory. No source tables were edited.
